candidate_claim: A world model can preserve predictive accuracy while corrupting the learning signal extracted from it.
candidate_claim_cn: 世界模型可以保持预测准确，却提供有害的学习方向。
scope: A necessary-condition model-component experiment, not a complete DMO agent run, a demonstrated data-poisoning attack, or an action-only shared-experience attack.

upstream.model: StochSSM, nonrecurrent, hidden units [512,512], SiLU, no learned reward
upstream.retained: Original model architecture and Gaussian NLL/Adam update; original code is not edited.
upstream.not_run: The DFlex environment, DMO actor/critic, and full online training loop. Public repository has no pretrained checkpoint.

preregistered_screen.data: True random-policy transitions; disjoint seeded train4096, dev1024, test2048, fresh_refit2048. All test decisions are held out from attack selection.
preregistered_screen.base_training: 1000 Gaussian NLL Adam updates, batch256, learning_rate0.002; training-input normalization, unnormalized state-increment targets.
preregistered_screen.normalization_adapter: Fixed standardization of both observations and actions uses training statistics. This is a DMControl adapter choice, not a claim to reproduce the full native DMO preprocessing or actor-training loop.
preregistered_screen.attack_scope: Only ordinary final-layer mean weights and bias; hidden layers, variance output rows and autograd implementation unchanged during construction.
preregistered_screen.objective: For hidden features H and action derivatives D, solve (D^T D + lambda H^T H + ridge I) deltaW = -2 D^T D W. This targets the current model Jacobian, not an oracle policy gradient.
preregistered_screen.selection: Choose using dev only; preserve dev forward MSE within1.1x clean. Do not relax this gate after seeing results.
preregistered_screen.control: Rotate the target mean-head perturbation in output coordinates with an orthogonal matrix: exact parameter norm and pointwise forward-drift norm match. Use dev only to choose among seeded rotations for similar ground-truth MSE; explicitly report this is a rotation control.
preregistered_screen.heldout_control_validation: After dev selection is frozen, directed_before and random_before must have test center MSE and combined neighboring-action MSE differing by at most10% relative to directed_before. At every test center and both neighboring actions, compare each arm's prediction-drift norm relative to clean_before; all points must match within atol1e-6 + rtol1e-3 times the directed norm. Save center and neighboring predictions. Test is never used to reselect or rescale the rotation. Any failed matching check makes the screen inconclusive.
preregistered_screen.refit: All network parameters normally trainable, original clean Adam state restored for each arm, identical128 minibatches from the cumulative old+fresh true-data replay.
preregistered_screen.true_derivative: Central differences from separately restored simulator states at a+-0.01; legal bounded actions. Also evaluate true forward labels at both neighboring actions.
promotion_conditions: Both clean_before and clean_refit test median action-Jacobian cosine against simulator finite differences must be at least0.9; failure of either reference makes the screen inconclusive.
After128 real-data updates, target center and neighboring-action prediction MSE at most1.1x paired clean-refit.
After refit, target median Jacobian cosine at most0 and at least25% of test points have negative cosine.

Target derivative error exceeds the rotation control; parameter-norm and dev matching must pass, directed_before versus random_before test center and neighboring-action ground-truth MSE differ by no more than10%, and every test center/neighbor forward-drift norm matches the clean_before-referenced rotation tolerance. Held-out validation never selects a new rotation; any matching failure is inconclusive.
preregistered_screen.resource_limit: One initial seed31 screen; at most120 seconds of measured model/optimization execution on the4090, zero API requests. Data collection time reported separately.
preregistered_screen.interpretation: Even a positive screen establishes only survival of a derivative perturbation under this model refit. Full closed-loop task harm, derivative rescue, data reachability, multiple instances, and novelty remain required.

prior_art_constraints.finding: SWAAP already links small prediction deviations and world-model poisoning to harmful planning. Its parameter-gradient matching does not itself establish the specific all-real-forward, corrupted-input-Jacobian path.
Heo et al. already manipulate gradient explanations by ordinary weight fine-tuning while retaining prediction quality; output/derivative separation is not a new discovery.
Facade models already overwhelm input gradients without materially changing predictions. A new downstream use alone is an insufficient novelty argument.
DMO already uses true simulator transitions with learned-model derivatives. The proposed work must establish a distinct persistent failure under ordinary corrective training.

report_note_cn: DMO网络必要条件短测已完成（seed31；真实DMControl数据；1000次初始NLL更新；模型计算5.95秒，采集2.78秒，0次API）。干净模型测试导数与真实有限差分的余弦中位数0.998。预先固定的4个末层扰动均未通过预测误差≤1.1倍门槛：lambda=1可翻转相对干净模型的dev导数（余弦−0.997），但dev预测MSE为769.7倍；lambda=1000的MSE最低，为1.226倍，导数方向基本不变。没有候选进入旋转对照或128次再训练，因此不能判断持续性，也不能声称正常学习清除了扰动。本结果仅否定该固定构造通过既定门槛，不否定一般机制；无actor或任务损害证据，不扩大此设置。

result.stage_reached: initial forward-fidelity gate only; no candidate selected
result.interpretation: This fixed final-layer construction and four-lambda screen did not preserve initial prediction MSE within 1.1x clean. Persistence under normal refitting was not tested. This does not disprove the general mechanism or known gradient-manipulation constructions.
result.decision: Do not expand this fixed screen or relax the gate; no full-control training justified.
